annotations.title: Estimate sales from Best Sellers Rank

description: Turns an Amazon Best Sellers Rank (the 'Best Sellers Rank' line on a book's Amazon page, overall store rank) into an estimated range of units per day and per month, using two independent public models. Amazon.com (Kindle Store or print); UK/DE are rough scalings. Optionally multiplies by royalty per sale.
name: bsr_to_sales
title: Estimate sales from Best Sellers Rank
